redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test__usage_core.py --selftest` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 with failing cases price: an unknown model is UNPRICED - None, never a fallback figure (house FAIL), price: a non-string model is the same unknown-model case (house FAIL) and 3 more, but with the working tree's implementation the task's tests do not all pass (SELFTEST FAILED: 91/92 cases passed), so the red is not one the fix turns green - SELFTEST FAILED: 26/32 cases passed; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD, PWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home)

outcome.technical: hooks/_config.py DEFAULTS[usage][pricing]: removed the shipped _default row, added claude-sonnet-5-5 (in 2, out 10, cacheW5m 2.50, cacheW1h 4, cacheR 0.10) and claude-haiku-5-5 (in 0.10, out 0.50, cacheW5m 0.125, cacheW1h 0.20, cacheR 0.01, the base/<=100k-token tier only), bumped pricingAsOf to 2026-10-10, documented the dated-row shape. scripts/usage/_usage_core.py: DEFAULT_PRICING/PRICING_AS_OF/PRICING_SOURCE_URL now loaded by path from hooks/_config.py (raw importlib, not _loader.load_hooks_config - that call would cross _usage_core's layer-1 floor upward into _loader's layer 2, a violation _deps.py (out of my files) refused when I tried registering it as known debt; the raw-importlib load keeps the same derivation goal without the edge, and PRICING_AS_OF is .strip()'d to match _deps.config_mirror conventions - confirmed via plugins/audit/tests/test__deps.py --selftest, 314/314). rates_for(model, table=None, at=None) and price(...) rewritten: a model entry may be a flat rate row (legacy, in effect always) or a list of {effectiveFrom, rates} rows, resolved by the latest effectiveFrom on or before at (today by default); no module-level _default fallback remains - an unmatched model (after exact/prefix/table-declared-_default lookup) returns None from rates_for and price, never a guessed figure. priced_at_read() now sets costUSD=None and unpriced=True for such a row instead of crashing on round(None). plugins/audit/scripts/config/_config_rules.py: _check_pricing split into _check_rate_row/_check_dated_rows, validating both shapes (effectiveFrom must match YYYY-MM-DD). plugins/audit/schema/audit-config.schema.json: usage.pricing additionalProperties now also accepts a dated-rows array via oneOf, keeping the flat-row properties at the top level so scripts/config/_help.py's dotted-path walker still discovers usage.pricing.<name>.in etc (confirmed via test__help.py --selftest, 104/104, after trimming the new schema description text to stay under the 200000-char help-payload budget). plugins/audit/scripts/panel/_panel_settings.py and plugins/audit/README.md and COMPATIBILITY.md: reworded the _default lookup description to say the shipped table ships no _default and an unmatched model is unpriced; COMPATIBILITY.md also documents the dated-row shape as an additive config-key promise. tools/stream-cost.py: _rate() and request_cost() return None/unpriced=True for a model with no row (previously _rate/request_cost could not fail); reconciliation()/render() print 'priced=unpriced' per model and a count of excluded unpriced models instead of folding them into the dollar total as 0; cache_economics(), class_table(), stage_table(), span_table() and cycle_reading() guard every cost-field read with `or 0.0` so a real unpriced request cannot raise. plugins/audit/templates/audit.config.example.json: bumped pricingAsOf to 2026-10-10, added claude-sonnet-5-5, removed its own _default row (kept the comparison in test__usage_core.py's tp1 honest) and reworded the usage note. New fixture plugins/audit/tests/fixtures/pricing-page-2026-10-10.md: the checked-in excerpt of both new rows' rates, which test__usage_core.py's pr7 case reads directly rather than re-typing the numbers. Tests: plugins/audit/tests/test__usage_core.py --selftest is green at 92/92 (was 91/92 red before the template fix, see redFirst); test_validate_config.py --selftest is green at 12/12; test__config.py (336/336), test__config_rules.py (153/153), test__help.py (104/104), test__deps.py (314/314), test__refs.py (334/334) and tools/stream-cost.py --selftest (51/51) were run as collateral checks and are green. NOT in this task's files and left unfixed, flagged for the orchestrator: removing the shipped _default broke plugins/audit/scripts/usage/_usage_routing.py (KeyError: _default) and its test (test__usage_routing.py, 6/7 cases, fails on the 7th with that KeyError), and likely plugins/audit/scripts/demo/gen-demo-manifest.py plus test_gen_demo_usage.py, test_audit_usage.py, test_audit_status.py and test__panel_page.py, none of which I touched - they read M.DEFAULT_PRICING['_default'] or ul.DEFAULT_PRICING['_default'] directly and need a follow-up task.
outcome.descriptive: Shipped Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 rows, dated rate rows, and an honestly-unpriced fallback (no more guessed _default) across the pricing table, its validator, schema, panel copy and tools/stream-cost.py.
